body: @jedie Ah, right, dots pass through unescaped and still cause a problem. Didn't think of that. We should probably just use the index instead; someone already suggested this once but I disregarded it, don't know why. Does `href="#repo-{{$index}}"` and the corresponding `id="repo-{{$index}}"` work?

using index way my idea ;)
IMHO the indexes are in the data set, but i didn't know how to implement this ;)

I had a vague memory that it was :) The reason I disliked the idea to start with was that the `$scope.repos` is a map, and so has no real index other than the repo ID that it's keyed on. _But_ that doesn't matter, because we do have an index when drawing the GUI (`$index` generated by angular) and that should work fine.
I'm currently on the latest version of synching (v0.8.12) across most of my devices, especially on my Linux OS's where I almost always run the latest version (thank you for the -upgrade feature).
